title: Grateful Dead Live at Community Concourse on 1970-01-10
lineage: RX (purported 2nd gen) > Technics RS-1506 > Grace Design Lunatec V3 [Pre-Only] > Korg MR-1000 > DSF [1-bit 5.6448 MHz Stereo] > Korg AudioGate > wav [24/96]

ai_review.summary: Great soundboard capture of a lively early‑70 set with standout Mason’s Children and a ferocious China Cat Sunflower.
ai_review.review: The recording is praised as crystal‑clear and “great,” indicating an excellent soundboard source. The performance is described as the band being "on" with Mason's Children highlighted by one reviewer and a fierce rendition of China Cat Sunflower lauded by another, while a third notes the set’s concise, refreshing brevity after the Fillmore East shows.

ai_rating.rationale: Three enthusiastic reviews (two 5‑star, one 4‑star) consistently praise the sound quality and highlight specific songs; weighting show (70%) and recording (30%) yields a strong overall rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clear, crisp sound with no reported drop‑outs or balance issues; reviewers explicitly call the audio "great" and a "true gem."

show_quality.setlist_flow: The set is noted for its brevity, offering shorter, refreshing renditions that differ from the extended jams of the preceding Fillmore East shows.

band_member_comments.Jerry: His playing is singled out as "fierce" on China Cat Sunflower and generally praised throughout.
